page.layout: One page of running text, beginning mid-sentence. Below it, an italic dedicatory signature and the name of the author, both set right of centre. At the foot, a gathering signature and a catchword.

main_text.p: uum gubernandum à Christo voca-tus, non in alium finem, quam in Chri-sti gloriam, in Ecclesiæ utilitatem, atq; ecclesiasticæ dignitatis patrocinium vivere se ac vigilare agnoscit. Hanc[?] ti-bi mentem Deus perpetuo confirmet, ut tuo exemplo alii complures in hoc deplorato seculo ad industriam & vi-gilantiam excitentur. Deus Opt. Max. te quamdiutissime incolumem ad Ec-clesiæ suæ ædificationem & dignita-tem conseruet.

page.notes: The first word "uum" is a fragment at the top of the page; its initial letter is not legible on the scan, so it is kept as printed. "Hanc" is read with a doubtful final letter (the scan shows a tailed letter, possibly "e"), so it is marked [?]. The signature line is set in italic and the author's name is in italic on its own line. The catchword "PRÆ-" and the signature "A 4" are at the foot. Long s has been normalised to s throughout; u/v and i/j were normalised to the vowel or consonant form.
